description: Use this first when the person asks to track, log or keep a record of something that keeps happening, or has a goal that needs one, like managing a budget or cutting down on something (bank transactions, Amazon orders, Shopify orders, Stripe payments, steps). Lists the ready-made tracks TrackerHacker can set up in one step. Each is one kind of sheet with fixed columns (sheet.columns) and one kind of row (row: "one row per …"); its answers only pick where rows come from and how the sheet looks, so every source of one ready-made (a bank, PayPal, Venmo) fills the same sheet. Use one only when what the person wants is one row per the same thing and its columns hold it; otherwise find_templates or create_custom_track.
name: list_ready_made
title: List ready-made tracks
